name: techpourtoutes
description: Plateforme web Django pour la communauté TechPourToutes.

scripts.copy-assets: mkdir -p ui/static/js && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js ui/static/js/htmx.min.js && cp node_modules/alpinejs/dist/cdn.min.js ui/static/js/alpine.min.js && mkdir -p ui/static/fonts/satoshi && curl -fsSL -o satoshi.zip https://api.fontshare.com/v2/fonts/download/satoshi && unzip -joq satoshi.zip Satoshi_Complete/Fonts/WEB/fonts/Satoshi-Variable.woff2 Satoshi_Complete/License/FFL.txt -d ui/static/fonts/satoshi && rm satoshi.zip && mkdir -p ui/static/fonts/mazius-display && for f in fonts/MaziusDisplay-{Regular,Bold,Extraitalic,ExtraItalicBold}.woff2 LICENSE.txt; do curl -fsSL -o ui/static/fonts/mazius-display/${f#fonts/} https://raw.githubusercontent.com/collletttivo/mazius-display/5798d69b14f0b7c1691f031f2ecb98ebdb709b54/$f || exit 1; done && curl -fsSL https://browser.sentry-cdn.com/11.8.0/bundle.min.js | sed '/sourceMappingURL/d' > ui/static/js/sentry.min.js
